topics.topic: Drain-or-close policy for unread request bodies on persistent connections
questions: When a surface answers or refuses before consuming the framed body, must the listener drain the remaining body, close the connection, or permit connection reuse by another mechanism?

When authentication, rights, session, CSRF, confirmation, or another header-level check produces an answer before the framed body is consumed, who discards the remaining body or closes the connection so the next request cannot be mistaken for it?
If a surface answers without consuming the entire framed body, does the listener drain the remaining body, close the connection, or permit another request, and who performs that operation?
